summary: Core navigation/header appears to have been simplified and some parts of the app are described as usable anonymously, but the diff still retains an explicit Internet Identity login screen/flow. Several unrelated UI/branding, theming, deployment, geolocation, and admin reset changes were also introduced that were not requested.

missing_requirements.requirement: Remove all Internet Identity login/signup user experiences from the UI: the app must not render or link to Internet Identity-specific screens or actions (e.g., LoginScreen’s "Sign In with Internet Identity" button and related messaging) anywhere in the app flow.
missing_requirements.reason: The Internet Identity login screen is still present and is explicitly described as an Internet Identity sign-in experience (including a sign-in button and login failure handling), which violates the requirement to remove II-specific screens/actions.
evidence: frontend-file-summaries.txt ("frontend/src/components/LoginScreen.tsx": "Internet Identity login screen with sign-in button...")

hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest is focused on removing Internet Identity prompts/flows and protecting admin routes; it does not request a global theme/branding overhaul.

hallucinated_features.description: Hans Laser branding and new header layout with logo and title text changes.

hallucinated_features.description: Silent background geolocation capture on report entry and attaching location to the report payload.
